label: Week 6
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
volume_note: Week volume is the sum of nightly volumes (volume_nights says how many nights had counts). The 2026-10-11 night is missing counts for 16 clubs: LV, LAC, LAR, MIA, MIN, NE, NO, NYG, NYJ, PHI, PIT, SEA, SF, TB, TEN, WSH, so loudest ranking uses volume_comparable_6n (Oct 12-17, all 32 clubs counted).
headline: Week 6 ran loudest in Buffalo, where Josh Allen's 121-yard rushing night in the Monday OT win over the Rams (career win No. 100) and his MVP chatter carried all week while DJ Moore's ironman streak ended. Seattle and Denver shared the Thursday room (Broncos 17-14 in OT, Bo Nix still under the microscope), Houston landed Marvin Harrison Jr. and headed to London for Jacksonville, and Baltimore lived on Huntley's OT rally in Atlanta and Lamar's ankle. New England (Maye's five TDs), unbeaten San Francisco (Deebo hurt, Khalil Mack talk), Philadelphia (London walk-off loss, Hurts to IR with a calf blood clot), Chicago (31-7 at Lambeau, Ditka's death, Caleb's return) and Dallas (Pettine hire) filled out the loud rooms. All seven nights logged, but Sunday night's counts were missing for 16 clubs, so loudest ranks use the six comparable nights. Vibe only.
